data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a prior year reserve strengthening of $11.224 million in 2020. This adverse development was primarily driven by increases in the estimated ultimate claims for the 2017 and 2018 underwriting years, as calculated from the gross claims development table. Specific factors contributing to prior year movements include an adverse movement related to the 2017 AXA/XL Whole Account Quota Share contract and a material loss from Typhoon Hagibis in 2019, alongside upward reassessments of casualty account ultimate loss ratios for the 2019 year of account. The syndicate also considers general claims cost inflation, social inflation, IBNR recalibration, and changes in reserve methodology as influencing factors.
